item.tib: skyes rabs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi 'da' kha'i zhal chems bung ba'i glu/ dad ldan mya ngan sangs pa'i sgra
item.coloph: rnal 'byor nyams kyi glu chung 'di/ bla ma nam mkha'i mno bsam/ dad ldan sems la a phob ltos/ stong nyid mkha' yangs dkyil 'khor nas/ 'od gsal nyi zla'i snyug gus bris/ gsal stong brda'i yig ris shar/ bkra shis nyi ma'i snying po las/ 'dzam gling zla ba'i dar rgyas shog/
